modifiers.name: Brisk Breeze
modifiers.description: Slightly tighter timing windows for lively calm-downs (stays cozy with Gentle Timing).

modifiers.name: Wind-Up Surge
modifiers.description: Bosses puff up with wind-up bubbles earlier and faster each rematch.

modifiers.name: Pure Heart
modifiers.description: No snacks allowed, with +10 bonus calm whenever you match a feeling!

bosses.title: Grumpy Gull
bosses.blurb: Lean into brisk coastal gusts on the sunlit lookout bench!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Grumpy Gull puffs up on the sunlit cliffside lookout!

bosses.title: Mr. Pip
bosses.blurb: Catch flying tokens and tickets in a playful high-score flurry!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Mr. Pip spins past the glowing cabinets with starry fizz!

bosses.title: Ms. Coral
bosses.blurb: Catch bouncing beach balls along the breezy harbor shore!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Ms. Coral blows her whistle over a sunny beach-ball volley!

bosses.title: Mrs. Flurry
bosses.blurb: Catch shimmering alpine snowballs outside Pinecone Lodge!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Mrs. Flurry scoops up sparkling snowballs in the mountain breeze!

bosses.title: Ms. Rowan
bosses.blurb: Trace glowing watercolor shapes across the bright art room!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Ms. Rowan flourishes her brush in a swirl of purple paint!

bosses.title: Mr. Bell
bosses.blurb: Trace gleaming stars through booming hallway announcements!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Principal Bell clears his throat with a booming school chime!

bosses.title: Starey Owl
bosses.blurb: Tiptoe through moonlit peekaboo watches in the quiet meadow!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Starey Owl blinks wide golden eyes beneath the quiet pines!

bosses.title: Chef Mateo
bosses.blurb: Fan away zesty taco clouds and share Cloverhollow favorites!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Chef Mateo waves his wooden spoon in a cloud of fiesta spice!

bosses.title: Ancient Tree Finale
bosses.blurb: Paint the purple scribbles back and reach a friend's heart!
bosses.encoreIntro: Dream Memory: Beneath the Ancient Tree, purple scribbles dance on the breeze!
